Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

            for k in range(1,d//s):
                rr=a+k*s
                if 0<=rr<H and out[rr][c]==bg: out[rr][c]=v
    return out

import json
def solve(inp):
    g=[r[:] for r in inp]
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt={}
    for r in g:
        for x in r: cnt[x]=cnt.get(x,0)+1
    # separator color: color of uniform rows/cols (must be non-bg)
    sepc=set()
    for r in range(H):
        if len({g[r][c] for c in range(W)})==1: sepc.add(g[r][0])
    for c in range(W):
        if len({g[r][c] for r in range(H)})==1: sepc.add(g[0][c])
    # bg = most common remaining color
    rem=[x for x,n in cnt.items() if x not in sepc]
    bg=max(rem,key=lambda x:cnt[x])
    # step: spacing between consecutive separator lines
    hsteps=[]; vsteps=[]
    rows_=[]
    for r in range(H):
        if all(g[r][c]==list(sepc)[0] for c in range(W)) if False else False: pass
    # detect separator rows/cols
    seprows=[r for r in range(H) if len({g[r][c] for c in range(W)})==1]
    sepcols=[c for c in range(W) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(H)})==1]
    if len(seprows)>1: hstep=seprows[1]-seprows[0]
    else: hstep=None
    if len(sepcols)>1: vstep=sepcols[1]-sepcols[0]
    else: vstep=None
    marks=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]!=bg and g[r][c] not in sepc]
    groups={}
    for r,c,v in marks: groups.setdefault(v,[]).append((r,c))
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for v,ps in groups.items():
        ps=list(set(ps))
        if len(ps)<2: continue
        rs={p[0] for p in ps}; cs={p[1] for p in ps}
        if len(rs)==1 and len(cs)>1:
            r=min(rs); cols2=sorted({cc for rr,cc in ps})
            a,b=min(cols2),max(cols2); d=b-a
            if vstep is None: continue
            s=vstep
            if d%s!=0: continue
            for k in range(1,d//s):
                cc=a+k*s
                if 0<=cc<W and out[r][cc]==bg: out[r][cc]=v
        elif len(cs)==1 and len(rs)>1:
            c=min(cs); rows2=sorted({rr for rr,cc in ps})
            a,b=min(rows2),max(rows2); d=b-a
            if hstep is None: continue
            s=hstep
            if d%s!=0: continue
            for k in range(1,d//s):
                rr=a+k*s
                if 0<=rr<H and out[rr][c]==bg: out[rr][c]=v
    return out

def f(inp):
    g=[r[:] for r in inp]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt={}
    for r in g:
        for x in r: cnt[x]=cnt.get(x,0)+1
    bgv=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    # separator color: most common non-bg color
    others=[v for v,n in cnt.items() if v!=bgv]
    sepc=max(others,key=lambda v:cnt[v])
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    marks={}
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            v=g[r][c]
            if v!=bgv and v!=sepc: marks.setdefault(v,[]).append((r,c))
    for v,ps in marks.items():
        ps=list(set(ps)); rs={p[0] for p in ps}; cs={p[1] for p in ps}
        rows2=sorted(rs); cols2=sorted(cs)
        if len(rs)==1 and len(cs)>1:   # horizontal line: pitch = vc
            c0=min(cols2)
            n_sep=sum(1 for cc in range(c0+1,max(cols2)+1) if all(g[r][cc]==sepc for r in range(H)))
            s=n_sep+1 if n_sep else 1  # approximate pitch
            # better: pitch from separator structure globally
            scand=[c for c in range(W) if sum(1 for rr in range(H) if g[rr][c]==sepc)>H*0.5]
            s=1
            if len(scand)>1: s=scand[1]-scand[0]
            r_=rows2[0]
            for cc in range(c0+1,max(cols2)+1):
                if (cc-c0)%s==0 and cc%W!=0: out[r_][cc]=v
        elif len(cs)==1 and len(rs)>1: # vertical: pitch vr
            r0=min(rows2)
            sr=[rr for rr in range(H) if sum(1 for cc in range(W) if g[rr][cc]==sepc)>W*0.5]
            s=None
            if len(sr)>1: s=sr[1]-sr[0]
            if s is None: s=1
            c_=cs.pop()
            for rr in range(r0+1,max(rows2)+1):
                if (rr-r0)%s==0: out[rr][c_]=v
    return out
